Dodo questions

What is the cheapest Dodo NBN plan?

Everyday NBN 25/10 at $43.99/mo for 6 months, then $73.99/mo. That is $707.88 over the first year (checked 29 August 2026).

Does Dodo let you opt out of CGNAT?

Not for free. Dodo only offers a public IP through a paid static IP add-on.

Do you need to give Dodo 30 days notice to cancel?

Yes. Dodo asks for 30 days notice, so you may pay for part of a month after you switch.

Which mobile network does Dodo use?

Dodo runs on the Optus Network, which covers about 98.5% of Australians.
